name: WRAITH OPS
detailed_description:
WRAITH OPS is a fast-paced tactical FPS built for satisfying gunplay and team-based objective combat. With snappy movement, precise shooting, and immersive tactical mechanics, it delivers a refined, back-to-basics experience. Designed to challenge and empower players, every feature enhances the action and never slows it down.

  • Overlord 12v12

  • Gun Game

  • Arena Mode

  • Team Death Match

WRAITH OPS will offer an arsenal of more than 38 weapons of various firepower, types and sizes on release! On release, you will be able to adjust and customize your weapons with various attachments (sights. muzzle devices, gadgets, camos, perks) that affect weapon handling and other stats.

When creating your loadout, you will be able to craft your perfect operator preset from the following options:

  • Primary, Secondary & Melee weapons

  • Throwables (Offensive, Defensive & Tactical)

  • Stimulants

  • Clothing, Gear, Camouflage & Patches

  • Class-specific Ability & Weapon Perk

  • Special Gestures, Nightvision & Tablet

In WRAITH OPS, there are two competing factions. Aegis Industries and Volga Battalion. Both Private Military Companies are tasked with achieving the same goal, investigating and retrieving remnants of a Cold War research project codenamed “Project Wraith”. Intel about their goal is scarce, but hints gathered by either side will take you to various places around the world. We aim to let you fight in as many locations as possible, but some locations may come later after release.

  • Complex

  • Airbase

  • Steelworks

  • Submarine

  • Mall

  • Arena

WRAITH OPS utilizes a dynamic weather system, allowing for runtime or config-based weather changes across all of our maps. Weather changes can be gradual or instant, allowing for a change of ambience.

  • Arsenal - Large variety of exotic weapons and attachments to choose from.

  • Customization - Variety of gear, clothing and camo to build your perfect Operator.

  • Ballistics and Penetration System - Fast TTK but with impactful aim. Headshots are rewarded.

  • Visual Fidelity - Gritty, atmospheric and as authentic as possible with great animations to make you feel immersed.

  • Community - Strong community focus. Our active presence shows our dedication to making a long-lasting game, not yearly abandonware.

  • Level Design - Immersive, well-thought-out maps with no unnecessary chokepoints, focus on fast-paced objective-oriented PVP experience

  • Damage Model - Realistic damage model.

  • Audio- Immersive, easy-to-pinpoint sound design. Satisfying gun sounds, loud and clear footsteps, focus on the sounds that matter.

  • Game Modes - Variety of game modes on launch, ability to host custom servers.

  • No Loot Boxes - Zero pay-to-win or aggressive, anti-player monetisation.

short_description: WRAITH OPS delivers snappy gunplay, fast movement, and objective-based combat with a focus on teamwork and skill. No grind, no gimmicks. Just pure infantry action where every fight matters. Get in, squad up, and take control.
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Arabic
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 8th gen/AMD Ryzen 3 series or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070 Ti or better
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 @ 60 FPS, Low Settings (AMD FSR Enabled)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 9th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or better
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 @ 80+ FPS, Medium Settings (DLSS/FSR Enabled)
